senses.sense_definition: The Latin name for Scotland, the northern part of the island of Great Britain.

examples.text: The Roman Empire never fully conquered the rugged lands of <w>Caledonia</w>.
Poets often refer to the wild beauty of <w>Caledonia</w> in their verses.

traits.comment: Used primarily in historical or literary contexts.

senses.sense_definition: A place name used for various towns and communities in North America, named after the Latin name for Scotland.

examples.text: Many settlers in Ontario named their new home <w>Caledonia</w> to remember their roots.
The small town of <w>Caledonia</w> is located in the heart of the province.
